1168-1479-5700-5701-8345.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1168-1479-5700-5701-8345.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Toggo trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

457-5078-5390-8346.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Forensic Gadgeteer triggers, creating a Clue token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping the Clue, adding {U}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield on top of your library.
Activate the Clue by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library.
Repeat.

573-2645-3430-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
573-2645-3430-7014.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

333-4247-8207.easyPrerequisites: Ferocity of the Hunt attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
333-4247-8207.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Shepherd of the Cosmos.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos dies, Ferocity of the Hunt triggers, returning Shepherd of the Cosmos from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Shepherd of the Cosmos enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Ferocity of the Hunt from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Shepherd of the Cosmos.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability
Repeat.

2595-2829-4694-7306.easyPrerequisites: Combine Guildmage does not have summoning sickness.
2595-2829-4694-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2595-2829-4694-7306.description:
Activate Combine Guildmage's first ability by paying {1}{G} and tapping it, causing each creature you control to enter with an additional +1/+1 counter this turn.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Combine Guildmage.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-4446-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-4446-5670--52.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
678-4446-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Relic Vial and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.n: Grist, Voracious Larva // Grist, the Plague Swarm

3305-4022-4772-5926-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability triggers, returning Grist, Voracious Larva from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Grist, Voracious Larva enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to pay {G} to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Grist, the Plague Swarm with six loyalty counters due to Doubling Season.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Grist, the Plague Swarm's third loyalty ability by removing six loyalty counters from it.
Grist, the Plague Swarm is put into your graveyard as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Grist, the Plague Swarm ability, creating two token copies of each creature card in your graveyard that are 1/1 Insects.
Put all but one of the Grist, Voracious Larva tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Grist, Voracious Larva and Hidden Herbalist tokens enter the battlefield, each Hidden Herbalist token triggers once and each Grist, Voracious Larva token triggers for each token created this way.
Resolve all Grist, Voracious Larva triggers, choosing not to pay.
Resolve both Hidden Herbalist triggers, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the Grist, Voracious Larva token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth.
Repeat from step 1, sacrificing a Body Launderer token instead.
3305-4022-4772-5926-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1981-2415-2438-5789.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-5789.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

3532-5078-7737-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

4499-7839-7911.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Gandalf.
When Gandalf enters, it triggers, dealing 3 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

851-5702-7798.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
851-5702-7798.description:
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the Forest that enters untapped.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 3.

1090-1739-2146-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Restoration Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Restoration Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Restoration Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

3617-4499-7722.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Time Walk, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Emiel the Blessed.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Time Walk from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Time Walk from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

223-1534-7411.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast an instant spell this turn.
223-1534-7411.description:
Cast Gravitic Punch by paying its mana cost, targeting Kalamax.
Holding priority, cast Twincast by paying its mana cost, targeting Gravitic Punch.
Kalamax's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first ability, creating a copy of Twincast targeting the original Twincast.
Resolve the second ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Kalamax.
Resolve the Twincast copy, creating a copy of Twincast, targeting the original Twincast.
Kalamax's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 6 any number of times.
Once you have an arbitrarily large Kalamax, have the final Twincast copy target Gravitic Punch. This'll create two copies of Gravitic Punch in addition to the original Gravitic Punch.
Resolve all Gravitic Punches, dealing infinite damage to each of up to three opponents.

343-4657-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands.
343-4657-5295-6871.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Regal Behemoth triggers three times, adding {3}
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
343-4657-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

4365-5742-5743-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Iron-Shield Elf ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

372-1922-6991.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Blur exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1922-6991.description:
Cast Blur by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Donnie & April and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Donnie & April trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Blur from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Blur.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Donnie & April and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

719-5853-6797.manaNeeded: {3}{B} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
719-5853-6797.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Phantom Train.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Xenograft, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

1339-2034-6713.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional creature with flash and/or haste
1339-2034-6713.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature with haste or flash.
When the creature dies, Shadow triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

643-1429-5226-5402.notablePrerequisites: Lesser Masticore does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
643-1429-5226-5402.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Lesser Masticore.
When Lesser Masticore dies,  its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters the battlefield, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat.

1274-3490-4506-4659.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4506-4659.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

710-1703-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Fool's Demise triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

141-167-5686.description:
Cost Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Not Dead After All, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Not Dead After All.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru meha dies, it and the Wicked Role token attached to it trigger.
Resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a Wicked Role token attached to it.
Repeat from step 7.

uses.n: Invasion of Segovia // Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia

3716-4113-5851.description:
Cast Fanning the Flames for X=0 with buyback by paying {3}, tapping Stormsplitter, and tapping Caetus.
Stormsplitter triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
Fanning the Flames resolves, returning itself to your hand.
Cast Fanning the Flames for X=0 with buyback by paying {4} and tapping the token copy of Stormsplitter.
Both Stormsplitters trigger, creating two token copies of Stormsplitter.
Fanning the Flames resolves, returning itself to your hand.
Cast Fanning the Flames for X=0 with buyback by paying {3} and tapping two token copies of Stormsplitter.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating four token copies of Stormsplitter.
Fanning the Flames resolves, returning itself to your hand.
Cast Fanning the Flames for X=0 with buyback by paying {1} and tapping four token copies of Stormsplitter.
Each Stormsplitter you control triggers, creating that many token copies of Stormsplitter.
Fanning the Flames resolves, returning itself to your hand.
Cast Fanning the Flames with buyback by tapping five token copies of Stormsplitter, tapping additional copies if desired to pay for an increased value for X.
Repeat from step 11.

3259-5223-5659.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5223-5659.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Disa the Restless's second ability.
Resolve the Disa the Restless trigger, creating a Tarmogoyf creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to and attach it to the Tarmogoyf token, then causing untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

964-4131-5647.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying {3}.
When Basalt Monolith enters the battlefield, Replication Specialist triggers, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a token copy of Basalt Monolith.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Roxanne's second ability triggers, adding {C}.
Activate the token Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

4125-5232-5718.description:
Cast Clone Legion by paying {7}{U}{U}, targeting yourself.
Shipwreck Dowser's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Shipwreck Dowser.
Put the token Hidetsugu and Kairi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Hidetsugu and Kairi token's first and second abilities trigger, as well as Shipwreck Dowser.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the first Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, causing you to draw three cards and then put Clone Legion and another card on top of your library, ensuring Clone Legion is on top.
Resolve the second Hidetsugu and Kairi trigger, exiling Clone Legion from the top of your library, then causing an opponent to lose 9 life and allowing you to cast Clone Legion from exile without paying its mana cost, targeting yourself.
Shipwreck Dowser's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve Clone Legion, causing you to create a token copy of Hidetsugu and Kairi and Shipwreck Dowser.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-3394-4191-5010.notablePrerequisites: Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
2034-3394-4191-5010.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Weatherlight Compleated trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Weatherlight Compleated trigger, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

2517-2822-3765-4460.description:
Cast Worldfire by paying {6}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, and setting each player's life total to one.
Parallax Wave leaves the battlefield, returning Kediss and Bloodswarn Steward from exile to the battlefield.
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Kediss.
The opponent dealt damage loses the game due to having less than zero life.
Kediss triggers, dealing damage equal to the combat damage dealt to each other opponent.
Each other opponent loses the game due to having less than zero life.

729-1363-3593.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{R}.
You control at least one additional creature.
Tradewind Rider does not have summoning sickness.
729-1363-3593.description:
Activate all mana producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {R}, putting Great Oak Guardian from your hand onto the battlefield.
Great Oak Guardian enters the battlefield, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Great Oak Guardian, and one other creature you control, returning Great Oak Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2370-2733-4050.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, attaching it to Bramble Elemental.
Bramble Elemental triggers, creating two 1/1  Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Saproling tokens, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
